resources.role: SCP palette data used by the native helpers

invocation.notes: Script entry; no entry_function. The library entries ghdot_build_matrices/ghdot_plot_panel/plot_scp_group_heatmap_dot are also loadable via source(code/core.R) into any env - core.R exposes only those names.

modifications: SCP::palette_list replaced with the local palette_list loaded from code/data/palette_list.rda
matrices and percent matrices are read from the render-group-heatmap table instead of computed from a Seurat object
add_violin, flip, feature_split, split.by, cell/feature annotation branches are rejected explicitly, not implemented
exp legend title and column split annotation defaults pinned to the observed native defaults
no draw(fig, rect, ...) adapter: entry returns the native patchwork-wrapped gTree; composition is caller-side via patchwork/grid

upstream eval(parse()) string interpolation for panel_fun/layer_fun replaced by closures over the same values, so group/matrix names and style strings are treated as data, not code (source-faithful: same grid calls, same geometry; upstream identical output reproduced byte-for-byte)
order columns validated as finite positive integers (>=1, non-contiguous allowed); key columns must be non-empty character strings

portability.scope: Isolated copy of the candidate (spec.json + declared code/ files + example data); new Rscript process in an unrelated directory; no SCP-local, SCP package source, or Wiki path provided; render.R script entry invoked.
